sloka: अभिनन्दाम ते सर्वे संश्रुत्येन्द्रजितो वधम् ।सो ऽवध्यः सर्वभूतानां महामायाधरो युधि ।। ७.१.३० ॥
transliteration: abhinandāma te sarve saṁśrutyendrajito vadham ।so 'vadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ mahāmāyādharo yudhi ।। 7.1.30 ॥

translations.english: All of us congratulate you upon hearing of Indrajit's death, for he was invincible to all beings and a master of great illusion in battle.
